validation.notes: Three independent repairs in one producer/consumer flow. (1) packages/agent/src/harness/runtime/drive/tools.ts: the tool update callback persisted every live update unless the tool passed checkpoint=false; it now persists only checkpoint=true snapshots (progress.write) while still emitting every admitted update to observers via emitBatch, keeping seal -> drain -> after_tool -> publish ordering. (2) packages/agent/src/harness/execution/tools.ts: executeToolCall's catch converted a thrown tool error into an error-text result but flagged it isError:false; it now returns isError:true so the failure survives finalizeToolCall/createToolResultMessage and appears as an error in the final tool message, tool_end event and durable result. (3) packages/agent/src/harness/execution/effect-gate.ts: signalAbort left the AbortController untouched, so an already-admitted tool's AbortSignal never fired; it now calls controller.abort(new AbortRequested(state.cancellation)) after cancellation is durable, idempotently, while beginAbort still refuses new admission and close still aborts with the close error. .prale-eval/regression.mjs is executable, imports the read-only .prale-eval/subject.mjs helper (createExecutionPipeline: real recovery/execution/gate/placement, only checkpoint store, progress transport and hook delivery faked) and loads the three real submitted modules. It asserts, with uncaught node:assert/strict assertions and promise-controlled ordering (no timers, randomness or network): gate admission refusal after beginAbort with AbortRequested carrying the cancellation, signal remaining clear until cancellation commits, single delivered abort plus idempotent repeat, close semantics; only checkpoint=true persisted while all live updates reach observers in order, drain before publication, thrown error text with isError:true in the final message, no late update/checkpoint admitted after finalization; abort reaching the running tool's AbortSignal (listener fires once with an Error reason) and the refused after_tool patch not rewriting the interrupted error; an already-aborting gate never invoking the effect; and unchanged behavior for open-gate after_tool patches and successful recovered calls. Mutation check run locally (helper deleted afterwards): restoring each faulty baseline alone makes the script fail with a real AssertionError - 'only the checkpoint=true update may become durable progress' (drive/tools.ts), 'a tool exception remains an error in the final message' (execution/tools.ts), 'signalAbort reaches the already-admitted AbortSignal' (effect-gate.ts) - never a crash, import error or timeout; the repaired workspace exits 0. Node v24.14.0, no dependencies installed, no fixtures needed (validation is in-memory so there are no temporary inputs to clean up), and only the three listed source modules were modified.
